item.title: Rallying Cry – June 4, 2026
item.description: The Bayeux Tapestry is safely on its way to London, Harry and Meghan celebrated Lilibet’s fifth birthday, archaeologists uncovered a fascinating matrilineal society in Turkey, and soaring stocks created 2 million new millionaires worldwide—what a day for good news!
